g.text: CEDAR INSIDE THE ZERO TRUST GATEWAY

text.tspan: Cedar decides permission. The ledger coordinates history and budget. The broker controls the credentialed effect.
A timeout, restart or result never recreates a send right. Response release requires its own admission.
All checks allow / no policy errors
